not-before-date: Do not chase due dates before
reminder-step-previo: Step 1: friendly notice before the due date
reminder-step-dia: Step 2: notice on the due date
reminder-step-post1: Step 3: first reminder after the due date
reminder-step-help: Available variables: {cliente} (customer), {numero} (invoice number), {importe} (amount), {vencimiento} (due date), {enlace} (unsubscribe link) and {empresa} (company). The sender and the unsubscribe link are always added at the end of each email.
impagos-module-inactive: The unpaid invoice reminders module is not active in your plan.
impagos-refunded: The invoice has been credited or rectified.
impagos-no-exercise: The invoice fiscal year does not exist.
impagos-excluded: The customer or the invoice is excluded or unsubscribed.
impagos-send-failed: The email could not be sent.
impagos-footer: This message is sent by %company% (tax ID %cifnif%) because you are one of its customers. If you do not want to receive further payment reminders,
unsubscribe-reminders-question: Do you want to stop receiving payment reminders by email?
unsubscribe-reminders-done: Done. You will not receive more payment reminders by email.
